body:
Part of #27252. This PR splits out the first roadmap item: simplify the prefill context parallel server args.

Summary:
- Adds canonical `--enable-prefill-cp` and `--cp-strategy {zigzag,interleave}`.
- Routes deprecated CP flags and mode flags into the unified fields.
- Mirrors unified fields back into legacy attrs so existing runtime paths keep working.
- Updates CP-related server-args tests and manual alias expectations.

Validation:
- Pre-commit hooks passed during commit.
- `python -m py_compile python/sglang/srt/server_args.py test/registered/unit/server_args/test_server_args.py test/manual/test_dsa_alias_cli_registry_env.py` passed locally.
- Full pytest was not run locally because this laptop Python environment does not have SGLang runtime/test dependencies installed.
